info.syllabusName: Đàm phán trong kinh doanh nhà hàng khách sạn (Negotiation in Hospitality Industry)
info.description:
Introduction

The Language of Negotiation 

Distributive Negotiations

Integrative Negotiations 

Conflict and Dispute Resolution 

Understanding Yourself and How That Impacts Negotiation

Communication in Negotiation

The Role and Importance of Persuasion in Negotiation

The Nature of the Relationship in Negotiating and Resolving Disputes

International Negotiations

Team and Multiparty Negotiations

Negotiating in The Workplace

Real Estate Negotiation: Commercial and Residential

Negotiating Your Future
